facts.fact: Monaco has the world's highest density of millionaires and billionaires per capita, making it a glittering haven for the ultra-wealthy.
facts.flagElement: the gold diamond in the upper left

facts.fact: The famous Monte Carlo Casino has been featured in multiple James Bond films and once funded the entire principality when Monaco was nearly bankrupt.
facts.flagElement: the pair of dice showing lucky seven in the center

facts.fact: Monaco's famous Grand Prix races through the actual streets of the city, including a tunnel and hairpin turn, making it the slowest yet most prestigious Formula 1 circuit.
facts.flagElement: the black and white checkered stripe along the bottom

decoys.overlap: Has extremely high concentration of millionaires and famous casinos, but lacks the Formula 1 street circuit heritage and Bond casino connection
